FPU op with extended (.x) memory source

d_observations.what: args pushed right to left, each in a 4-byte slot; char/short constants widened
(last argument pushed first, first argument last before the call)
prototyped float argument passed as 4-byte float (4.5f = 0x40900000)
unprototyped call promotes float to double (3.5 high word 0x400c0000 = 1074528256)
long double argument: 12 bytes on the stack
callee reads char argument at the low byte of its slot a6@(11)
callee reads short argument at a6@(10)
signed char result sign-extended to 32 bits by the callee
unsigned char result zero-extended by the callee
pointer result in d0
float result in d0 (not fp0)
double result in d0:d1 (high word in d0)
long long result in d0:d1 (high in d0); argument high word at a6@(8)
long double result stored through a1, a1 copied to d0
(address returned in d0)
mixed args: double at a6@(12) after a char slot (no 8-byte alignment)
mixed args: float at a6@(24) stays 4 bytes
old-style definition: float parameter arrives as double at a6@(16)
struct{char} (2 bytes) passed right-justified in a 4-byte slot
struct{char} result in d0
struct{int,int} result in d0:d1
struct{int[3]} result through a1 (address also in d0)
struct{double} (8 bytes) result through a1, not d0:d1
caller passes the result buffer in a1
plain int bitfield is signed (bfexts)
callee-saved: d2-d7, a2-a5 (moveml predecrement mask 0x3f3c)
callee-saved FP: fp2, fp3 used and saved (fmovem predecrement mask 0xc)
double to int: FPCR rounding set to toward-zero around fmovel
external call is jbsr (assembled as bsr.l, 68020 32-bit displacement)
frame: pea a6@ / movel sp,a6 instead of link when no locals
varargs callee: promoted char at a6@(12), short at a6@(16)
varargs: double at a6@(20), long long at a6@(28) (4-byte slots, no 8-byte alignment)
varargs: 4-byte struct at a6@(40)
inline asm "=a" -> a0
inline asm "=dm" -> d0
inline asm "Jdm" with constant 0x2700 -> immediate
-fwritable-strings: each literal in __data, no merging
